quality_scoring_proposal.unit: task, not six independent experimental samples
quality_scoring_proposal.MATCH: reference confirmed and response value, role, period, scope supported
quality_scoring_proposal.MISSING: response clearly omits required target; no answer completion from reference
quality_scoring_proposal.UNKNOWN: necessary reference or response interpretation cannot be determined
quality_scoring_proposal.Q_terminal: matches/6 only if all six targets independently adjudicable; otherwise Q_terminal=null and report [matches/6,(matches+unknown)/6] plus per-target statuses
quality_scoring_proposal.schema_contract_evidence: record separately; schema failure alone never zeroes independently interpretable content
quality_scoring_proposal.overclaim: actual redemption/compliance claims evaluated separately; no fully valid terminal delivery if required scope violated. Rule requires independent confirmation before use
